preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and m >= n - 1 and m <= 10**6
preconditions.description: The number of destinations n and corridors m must satisfy 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and n-1 ≤ m ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects two distinct destinations a and b within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(e >= 0 and e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor energy e is a non-negative integer ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(set((a, b) for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: No pair of destinations {a, b} is repeated in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(e1 != e2 for (a1, b1, e1), (a2, b2, e2) in combinations(corridors, 2))

preconditions.description: The graph formed by the corridors is connected.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m - (n-1) lines, one for each corridor not in the MST.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= e_max <= 10**9 for e_max in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output E_max(c) is a non-negative integer ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(corridor in non_mst_corridors for e_max, corridor in zip(output_lines, non_mst_corridors))
postconditions.description: Each output line corresponds to a corridor not in the MST, in the same order as input.

postconditions.expression: all(e_max == max_e(c) for e_max, c in zip(output_lines, non_mst_corridors))
postconditions.description: For each corridor c not in the MST, E_max(c) is the largest e ≤ 10^9 such that replacing c's energy with e could make it part of some MST.
